description: This file defines the SettingsRootView SwiftUI view component for a macOS application, managing various settings tabs, UI layout, and associated behaviors.

classes.name: SettingsRootView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that manages the application's settings interface with multiple configurable tabs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SettingsRootView with application state, updater, and optional initial tab.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view layout with tab views, banners, and event handlers.

methods.name: nixManagedBanner
methods.description: Constructs a banner view indicating configuration managed by Nix with paths info.

methods.name: validTab
methods.description: Validates requested tab selection based on app state.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves snapshot paths and updates state.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the active tab.
